topic: Day 41 — carousel — Ask for what you need, don't wait to be guessed correctly

slides.text: Waiting to be understood puts the burden on their guesswork.
Unspoken needs create resentment when they go unmet.
Guessing is a fragile substitute for asking.

caption:
Waiting to be understood without ever stating the need clearly puts the entire burden of intimacy on someone else's guesswork.

Follow for one of these a day.
